visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A right hand holds a smartphone encased in a vibrant pink silicone case with a small antenna-like protrusion at the top. The screen displays a social messaging application where a man in a black headband and a thick white fur-collared jacket is visible in a blurred chat photo. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of a young woman with short black hair and bangs, wearing a fuzzy lavender-purple cardigan. She is positioned against a background of textured red bricks. She smiles broadly, revealing her teeth, and raises her right index finger as she articulates. (3) The camera returns to the smartphone screen. A thumb enters the frame and performs a long-press action on the central image, causing the circular 'expired' loading icon and associated text to be dragged horizontally across the screen, revealing the clear image of the man underneath. (4) The shot shifts back to the woman in the purple cardigan. She continues speaking with animated facial expressions, pointing toward the viewer with her right hand while her left hand rests near her collarbone. (5) The final sequence is an extreme close-up of the woman's face. She transitions from a questioning look to a high-arousal expression with her eyes wide and her mouth fully open in a shouting posture, filling the majority of the frame.
